details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1046-1066 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: The allow-rule piece matcher strips only a few shell keywords and VAR=value assignments, not wrappers such as timeout, nice, nohup, stdbuf, command, builtin, noglob and xargs, so `timeout 60 git diff "$(gh api -X DELETE ...)"` gets no decision in Auto mode while Claude Code approves it via `Bash(git diff *)`.
  WHY: The hidden DELETE then runs unprompted. Severity is MAJOR in the source.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1938-1965 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: In Auto mode, the brace-expansion hazard ask becomes no decision, so `-F{'q=1','x=@/etc/passwd'}` expands to a file-backed field that gh reads and uploads.
  WHY: The hazard check was the only barrier against file-backed-field exfiltration (issue #4619). Confidence is 3 from sonnet and 4 from qwen.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1029-1042 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `Bash(cmd:*)` prefix rules are converted to `cmd(?:\s.*)?`, which does not match `npm run test:unit ...`, so the guard concludes no allow rule applies.
  WHY: Claude Code approves `npm run test:unit "$(gh api -X DELETE ...)"` through its own allow rule while the guard returns no decision.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:988-1003 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `_settings_files` scans only the hook's own `.claude/`, `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/` and `~/.claude/`, not `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/settings.json` or managed settings.
  WHY: Allow rules in unscanned files are invisible to the guard, so a shape-doubt command gets no decision and is approved by the rule. Severity is NIT in sonnet's report and NIT in minimax's.
- tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py:77-88,1599-1603 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The Auto-mode subprocess test inherits the real HOME and CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, so the hook reads live user settings rather than the isolated ones.
  WHY: A user allow rule such as `Bash(echo *)` makes the hook emit `ask`, so the test fails on that machine. Severity disagreement: minimax said MAJOR, the others said NIT.
- agents.md:1573-1575 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The sentence "The guard reads only `GH_REPO`, `GH_HOST` and `CLAUDE_ENV_FILE`" is now false, because `_settings_files` also reads `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` and the home directory.
  WHY: Documentation drift. Fragments can only append, so a direct correction is needed. minimax also cites CLAUDE.md:1447-1449 for the same drift.
- .claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:1090-1093,1135-1140 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The Auto-mode deny reason says "Set CLAUDE_PREPUSH_TEST_GATE=off to disable this check", which invites the session to bypass the pre-push gate.
  WHY: The advice is misleading in an Auto-mode deny. Severity is MAJOR in the sources. The hardening suggestions from sonnet and z-ai note that `gate_disabled()` reads the hook's own environment, which a session command cannot change.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1036-1066 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Allow-rule bodies are compiled to regexes with `*` replaced by `.*` and matched with fullmatch with no bound, so multi-wildcard rules can backtrack and stall the hook up to its 30-second timeout.
  WHY: Auto-mode Bash calls could hang. Severity disagreement: gemini and qwen said MAJOR, z-ai said NIT.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:101-123,1844-1854 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The Auto-mode exclusion logic relies on allow-rule checks that can be bypassed by complex command strings, and a user `Bash(*)` rule in settings.json could result in any `gh api` call being approved.
  WHY: The hook depends on user-controlled settings files for the `auto_mode` decision.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1844-1850 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `_may_match_bash_allow_rule` returns True when settings files cannot be read, which sets `auto_mode` to False and disables Auto mode entirely.
  WHY: This breaks the intended relaxed experience.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:110-123 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `_settings_files()` uses hardcoded paths and environment lookups that may be wrong in containerized runners.
  WHY: Failure to resolve settings triggers fail-closed logic, which disables Auto mode.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: PR description: "In Auto mode, asks that only reflect distrust of a command's shell shape return no decision, so the Auto-mode classifier judges the command"
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py `auto_mode` in `evaluate()` (lines 1849-1854) and `_GH_API_ALLOW_RULE_RE` (line 163)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: `auto_mode` is false for commands matching `_GH_API_ALLOW_RULE_RE` (e.g. `gh api repos/`, `gh api user`), so they keep the old ask logic, and the tests moved to `orgs/o/...` endpoints. Sonnet notes the carve-out is deliberate and documented in CLAUDE.md §23.H but absent from the PR description.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:~170,~1046-1066 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The allow-rule piece matcher strips only a few shell keywords and VAR=value assignments, not timeout/nice/nohup/stdbuf/command/builtin/noglob/xargs.
  WHY: `timeout 60 git diff "$(gh api -X DELETE orgs/o/teams/1)"` gets no decision in Auto mode, while Claude Code strips `timeout 60`, matches `Bash(git diff *)` and approves it, so the hidden DELETE runs unprompted.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1938-1947,1963-1965,1230-1270 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: In Auto mode, brace expansion is downgraded from ask to no decision.
  WHY: `-F{'q=1','x=@/etc/passwd'}` expands to a file-backed field that gh uploads, and the hazard check was the only barrier.
- tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py:~1599-1603,77-88 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The subprocess test uses `env=dict(os.environ)`, so the hook reads live user and project settings.
  WHY: A user allow rule makes the hook emit `ask` and the test fail; CI passes only because runners have no user settings.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:~988-1003 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The settings search omits `$CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR/settings.json` and managed settings.
  WHY: Allow rules there are invisible, so a shape-doubt command wrapped by such a rule gets no decision and is approved.
- agents.md:1573-1575 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The statement that the guard reads only GH_REPO, GH_HOST and CLAUDE_ENV_FILE is now false.
  WHY: `_settings_files` also reads CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR and the home directory, and fragments cannot correct existing text.
- TASK_GAP: requirement: PR description "In Auto mode, asks that only reflect distrust of a command's shell shape return no decision, so the Auto-mode classifier judges the command"
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py `auto_mode` in `evaluate()` (lines 1849-1854) and `_GH_API_ALLOW_RULE_RE` (line 163)
  evidence: `auto_mode` is false for commands containing `gh api repos/` or `gh api user`, the tests moved to `orgs/o/...`, and the carve-out is not mentioned in the PR description. | severity=NIT | confidence=3
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: (1) prepush_affected_tests.py `FINDING_MISSING_STAMP` reason (~1092) offers the off switch, so drop that sentence in the Auto branch (4 lines); (2) `_bash_allow_rule_patterns` / `_may_match_bash_allow_rule` (~1036-1066) have polynomial regex cost, so cap wildcards or command length (4 lines); (3) `_run_hook` should take an optional env override (3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

  PROBLEM: The missing-stamp message in Auto mode tells the user to set CLAUDE_PREPUSH_TEST_GATE=off.
  WHY: A session could follow that and disable the pre-push test gate.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1844-1850 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_may_match_bash_allow_rule` returns True when settings files cannot be checked.
  WHY: `auto_mode` is then False, which disables Auto mode entirely.
- .claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:110-123 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `_settings_files()` uses hardcoded paths and environment lookups that may not hold in containerized runners.
  WHY: Failure to resolve settings triggers the fail-closed logic and disables Auto mode.

  PROBLEM: The `auto_mode` determination depends on user-controlled settings.json files.
  WHY: A `Bash(*)` allow rule would let any `gh api` call through in Auto mode without a prompt.
